_notes: Fixture 21CQ30960 DEFECTS — Phase 30 Plan 09. The SAME project as tests/Fixtures/rams/21cq30960/record.json at an EARLIER point in time: this models RAMS 97's (2026-08-25) pre-fix shape, the professional review that produced GATE-13 and GATE-14 in the first place. Hand-crafted by the Plan 09 executor 2026-09-14 (the real pre-fix record is not accessible from the dev environment); modelled on the tilda-21cq29531 precedent for shape/style and on StructuralGatesDisarmedTest.php's allFiveViolatingDocument() for the keyword-collision-avoidance technique used to build a genuine, uncited-but-present GATE-14 gap. Regeneration is NOT applicable to this fixture — it is a GATE fixture only (fed directly to RamsComplianceUpgradeService::upgrade()), never wired into the snapshot suite (see 30-09-PLAN.md Task 2 — snapshotting deliberately-broken output would lock in the breakage as golden). Assumption A6 applied: the real document's RA numbering is unverified from this environment, so this fixture's hazard register is deliberately SMALL (4 rows, not the real document's full register implied by 'RA11/12/13/21') and renumbered RA01-RA04; the defect CLASS is reproduced faithfully, not the literal row positions. Two defects, reproduced as follows: GATE-13 (hot-works contradiction) — hazard[3] asserts 'No hot works will be undertaken on this site.' (an absence assertion) while generated_data.coshh_baseline lists Tin/Lead Solder and Rosin Flux — the COSHH half of GATE-13 fires on this. IMPORTANT CORRECTION recorded here (a Rule-1 finding during this plan's authoring, not assumed from the plan text): the PERMIT half of GATE-13 can NEVER be demonstrated through the real upgrade() pipeline, because RamsComplianceUpgradeService::addPermitAndIsolation() unconditionally OVERWRITES $data['permit_and_isolation'] with its own fixed, conditionally-worded rule set on every upgrade() call (':999-1013' — 'Hot works permit required IF soldering...') regardless of what this fixture supplies — this is the exact, already-documented D-02/config/rams_tier1.php:216-231 limitation ('The permit half is equally unready'), re-confirmed here rather than re-stated from the plan's illustrative prose. This fixture therefore carries no permit_and_isolation input of its own; GATE-13 fires via the COSHH half only, and the StructuralGatesRealDocumentTest assertion is written against that reality. GATE-14 (missing risk reference) — the 'Step 4 — Overhead Access and Fixing' phase's own text ('...use a stepladder to access the upper fixing points...') implies the mounting_above_reach signal, which resolves to hazard[0] ('Working at height — installation above standing reach', RA01) — present in the register but NOT cited in that phase's associated_risks (crossReferenceMethodStatementRisks() auto-cites only RA03/electrical for this phase; verified during authoring that no $keywordRiskMap keyword pair is shared between this phase's text and hazard[0]'s name, so the gap is genuine, not one the app's own auto-citation had already closed). Hazard[1] ('Manual handling of large-format displays (58 kg lift)', RA02) is ALSO present and ALSO uncited by this phase, reproducing the canonical Step-4 defect's second omission faithfully — but GATE-14 CANNOT detect it and will not warn on it: config/rams_tier1.php's missing_risk_implications map (Plan 30-01) defines only two signals (mounting_above_reach, ceiling_void_access); no manual_handling signal exists in StructuralGateVocabulary::SUPPORTED_SIGNALS or HazardIncludeWhenResolver's const maps. This is the corpus-fidelity gap Plan 30-08's SUMMARY already recorded for Phase 31/measurement, not something this plan fixes — RA02's uncited presence in this fixture is deliberate documentation of that gap, not a test failure to chase.
